module_summary: XOR of a and b implemented three ways: continuous assign, combinational always, and a clocked flip-flop that delays the result.

anchors.name: out_assign
anchors.why: Combinational XOR of a and b via continuous assign.

anchors.name: out_always_comb
anchors.why: Same XOR via combinational always block; identical circuit to out_assign.

anchors.name: out_always_ff
anchors.why: Registered XOR: flip-flop delays result by one clock cycle.

groups.name: xor_logic
groups.description: Combinational XOR gates of a and b.

groups.name: xor_register
groups.description: Flip-flop capturing a^b on each clock edge.
